row.title: STICKY-1: every system is judged on freshness, breadth, depth and diversity of content and promotes it
row.body: Core module workers/core/stickiness (vendored in the seed) and tick step stickiness measure each system's JSON Feed, record a daily series, file STICKY-<id> while stale/thin/narrow, and serve unpromoted entries as a social queue. Admission is a stickiness block in instances/ultrastable/progress.json. Unlearn is a shrink-only baseline with no feed of its own; the ultrastable.io feed is the changelog, last updated 2026-11-17, so the loop will file STICKY-ultrastable.
